title: Ant Ling's new multimodal model recreates rotating 3D scenes from single 2D reference images
author: _Ihavenofuturehere_
selftext:
The 3D reel accompanying Ant Ling's new Ling-3.2-flash shows reference images beside reconstructed scenes and objects that can be viewed from different angles.

The examples range from a stylized shop and a windmill landscape to furnished interiors, a lantern and a camera. Ant Ling describes the workflow as recreating assets for game and simulation prototyping from 2D references, with repeated render inspection and refinement.

The moving views show how each reference has been interpreted spatially, including the objects and their arrangement within the recreated scene.
